rules.truth: Power drains. Restore it at the fuse boxes. In the dark, the thing in the aisles hunts.

rules.text: Something reads the files when you are not looking.
rules.truth: It only reads while unobserved. Looking at it makes it stop and move.
It is reading the 1998 incident report. Collect all six torn pages before it does.
rules.clue: Pages turn faster as it gets closer to the end.
